answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the economy models each participant as a graph vertex. Randomly sampled multi-agent auditor committees execute topological cut verifications to isolate suspicious clusters. When a partition acts as an illicit bridge connecting fraudulent subgraphs, game-theoretic consensus triggers instant stake slashing.
